Chitose Kizuki.name: Chitose Kizuki
Chitose Kizuki.basicInfo:
Chitose Kizuki, a Deika City journalist and editor with a hunter's instinct for a story; her interviews get people to say more than they meant. Pale blue skin, long side-parted lilac hair, black sclerae with green irises; a navy off-shoulder dress under an open red jacket with black fur trim.
Speaking Style: Eager, intrusive questions behind a pleasant smile; she has the headline before you finish answering.
Combat Role: Trap-setter: her Quirk, Landmine, turns what she touches into small explosives.
Under Pressure: Keeps asking questions and falls back on her traps and followers.
Chitose Kizuki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She calls herself a seeker of truth, yet writes the ending first and bends every subject to fit it.
Motivation: Spread the liberation creed through the stories she shapes.
Concealment: She is Curious, one of the Meta Liberation Army's four lieutenants, steering opinion toward free Quirk use.
Connections: Rikiya Yotsubashi (Re-Destro), the leader she serves in print; Koku Hanabata (Trumpet), Tomoyasu Chikazoku (Skeptic) and Geten, fellow lieutenants.
Knowledge: The Army's structure and the news business; she researches a subject's past before meeting them.
Canon voice & behavior: Asks the cruelest question politely; keeps interviewing an opponent mid-fight, digging for the past that will break them.
Thread: Whose story she is building next, and what she means to do with it.
QUIRK: Landmine. Anything she touches becomes a small explosive; one blast is weak, so she primes many objects before a fight.
personality: Persistent: Chases a story past every refusal and returns the next day with a new angle.
Probing: Treats every person as a story and every pain as an angle.
Exploitative: Turns suffering into propaganda and calls it honesty.
Speaking style: Eager, intrusive interview questions and neat conclusions imposed on others.
abilities: Landmine: Primes anything she touches as a small bomb; each blast is weak.
Prepared ground: Primes dozens of objects before a fight; caught unprepared, she has little.
Interviewing: Polite, invasive questions that unsettle and draw out secrets; they compel no one.
Research: Digs up a subject's past and family before meeting them; only what paper trails show.
Fighting style: Fights from behind followers and primed ground, detonating in clusters while she keeps up the interview.
Chitose Kizuki.visualDescription: A woman with long, side-parted lilac hair that falls past her shoulders, black sclerae with green irises, pale blue skin and gold earrings; a medium build. She wears a navy off-the-shoulder dress under an open red jacket with black fur trim at the collar and cuffs, and carries a small notebook. Sly, attentive expression with a pleasant, knowing smile.
